policy: Primary manufacturer or standards-owner sources only. URLs and lifecycle status must be rechecked at each release gate.

evidence.title: NINA-B3 series Data sheet, UBX-17052099 R15, 3-Jun-2025
claims_checked: NINA-B302-00B-00 is listed in mass production with an internal metal PIFA antenna.
VCC and VCC_IO are 1.7 to 3.6 V and VCC_IO must be connected to VCC.
Pins 54 and 55 are USB_DP and USB_DM, pin 31 is VBUS, pins 11 and 15 are SWDCLK and SWDIO, and exposed ground pads must be grounded.
NINA-B302 uses the internal antenna; the B301 antenna pin must not be repurposed on the B302 assembly variant.

evidence.title: NINA-B3 System Integration Manual, UBX-17056748 R15
claims_checked: SWD access, short/wide supply routing, local decoupling, solid module ground and antenna-area integration review are required.
Integrated-antenna variants must not be enclosed by metal and finished-product radio/compliance obligations remain with the integrator.

evidence.title: LSM6DSV16X Datasheet DS13510 Rev 4
claims_checked: VDD is 1.71 to 3.6 V and VDD_IO is 1.08 to 3.6 V.
I2C mode requires CS high; SDO/SA0 selects the address; VDD and VDD_IO each require local 100 nF decoupling.
Unused auxiliary/Qvar pins require the data-sheet-supported termination selected in the connectivity table.

evidence.title: BQ25185 Datasheet SLUSF65A, revised Jan-2026
claims_checked: IN needs at least 1 uF, SYS 10 uF nominal with at least 1 uF effective after bias, and BAT at least 1 uF.
The 5 V, 4.2 V, 300 mA charge and 500 mA input-limit example uses 1.00 kOhm ISET and 18.0 kOhm ILIM/VSET.
TS/MR directly supports a 10 kOhm at 25 C NTC with beta(25/85) 3435 K; different thermistors can require compensation.
STAT outputs are open drain and accept 1 kOhm to 20 kOhm pull-ups.

evidence.title: TPS63900 Datasheet Rev D
claims_checked: The 3.3 V application uses a 2.2 uH inductor, 10 uF input and 22 uF output capacitors.
16.2 kOhm on CFG3 programs 3.3 V VOUT1; 36.5 kOhm on CFG1 programs 3.3 V VOUT2; CFG2 at 0 Ohm selects no programmed input limit.
EN, SEL and CFG pins must not float.

evidence.title: DRV2605L Datasheet Rev D
claims_checked: VDD operating range is 2 to 5.2 V.
REG requires 1 uF; VDD uses local 1 uF and 100 nF; IN/TRIG is grounded when unused.
OUT+ and OUT- are a differential actuator drive and are not grounded.

evidence.title: TPS6216x Datasheet Rev E / TPS62162 product record
claims_checked: TPS62162 is active, fixed 3.3 V, accepts 3 to 17 V and is rated to 1 A.
The exposed pad is grounded and the fixed-output feedback/voltage-sense connections must follow the data sheet.

evidence.title: SN74LVC2T45 Datasheet Rev N
claims_checked: Both rails accept 1.65 to 5.5 V and the device is direction controlled.
DIR reference and power sequencing must follow the data sheet; the 8-pin device has no dedicated OE pin and unused inputs cannot float.

evidence.title: TLP291(SE Photocoupler product record and English datasheet
claims_checked: Phototransistor output provides a floating collector/emitter signal interface.
The base TLP291 product is not recommended for new design; exact TLP291(SE order code and agency option require procurement recheck.
Isolation component recognition does not certify the receiver or permit mains conductors on this PCB.

evidence.title: CSD17313Q2 30 V N-channel NexFET Datasheet Rev E
claims_checked: Device is active, 30 V and logic-level; package current does not define the board output rating.
3 V gate-drive resistance and safe temperature must be checked for the exact operating point.

evidence.title: USBLC6-2 Datasheet DS4260 Rev 7
claims_checked: Two low-capacitance USB data channels are supported and VBUS/GND bias pins must be connected as specified.
Placement is adjacent to the connector with a short ground return and no protected/unprotected trace overlap.

evidence.title: nRF52840 Product Specification and S113 feature record
claims_checked: nRF52840 supports BLE 1 Mbps and hardware AES-CCM capabilities.
Nordic BLE stacks support LE Secure Connections; the selected SDK/stack and configuration still require build-time evidence.

evidence.title: USB Type-C Cable and Connector Specification Release 2.5, April 2026
claims_checked: A sink-only receptacle uses independent Rd terminations on CC1 and CC2.
Following the electrical intent does not constitute USB-IF certification or logo authorization.
